svg.title: How engineering roles change
svg.desc: Engineers spend less time on repetitive implementation and more on understanding problems, validating assumptions and checking behaviour. Architects shift from producing documents to setting context, constraints and decision boundaries for AI agents. Engineering leaders rethink team design, how quality is measured and how accountability is kept.

text.font-family: 'DM Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: THE ROLE OF ENGINEERS AND ARCHITECTS

svg.text: Judgment moves to where it matters most.
